verdict.rationale: PayPal exposes REST APIs for subscription plans, invoicing, and an Agent Toolkit/MCP server that let agent frameworks call PayPal APIs via function calling, suggesting an agent could in principle create a plan/price and invoice/payment resource. However, there is no explicit evidence of a unified 'Product' + 'Price' + 'Payment Link' API resource (Payment Links are described as a no-code website feature, not an API call), so a single-session end-to-end agent provisioning flow is not clearly documented.
